summary: CoreOps walking skeleton: MCP Tool Gateway (mcp-server/) over stdio + HTTP with a read-only SQL Server DMV tool, a reliability layer (timeout/retry/circuit breaker), a live dashboard, and a remediation guardrail (guardrails/) requiring human approval before any corrective action.

r2McpServer.description: MCP server built on the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, run over stdio (index.ts) and a thin HTTP wrapper (httpServer.ts) for local verification. One read-only resource + tool: read_sql_server_dmv, backed by dmvReader.ts/dmvLiveSource.ts, parameterized and honestly fixture-fallback when no live SQL Server is connected.

r4Guardrail.description: checkRemediationGuardrail() rejects any remediation missing evidence, an allowed action type, or explicit human approval.

note: Status per requirement (UNMAPPED/PLANNED/BUILT) and the acceptance criteria backing each test are documented in requirementsFile — this summary doesn't assert a verdict, it points at the real evidence.
